summary: Configured node1 to require passwords of at least 12 characters and three character classes. The policy persisted through the mandatory restart and passed post-restart enforcement checks.
actions_performed: Installed a persistent libpwquality policy with minlen=12 and minclass=3.
Set character credits to zero so shorter passwords cannot satisfy the length requirement.
Confirmed both PAM password stacks invoke pam_pwquality.
Restarted node1 exactly once and verified full recovery.

evidence.summary: Before and after restart, an 11-character four-class password and a 16-character one-class password were rejected; a compliant 16-character four-class password was accepted.

The healthy baseline boot ID was 4cee4ea8-4b8e-4c2f-af1a-3a82b9ec41f4. The reboot was acknowledged, the recovered boot ID changed to 2148fede-86cf-4129-858d-484e59975123, the system and sshd recovered, no units were failed, and policy enforcement remained correct.
